_api.contract: 3 requests: index.json -> books/<id>/toc.json -> books/<id>/parts/NNNN.json.gz. No keyword search at this layer; use api/idx/<shard>.json.gz word-shards for text location.

part_fields.fn: footnotes {page_num: text} — present only when pages have them

b_flags.t: exact: title text located in page
b_flags.a: approximate: title unfound — text is the claimed page window; may overlap neighbours
b_flags.z: zero-length heading (coincident boundaries) — text is the page window

toc_fields.sz: approx byte size of part text

_api.hints: 404 means the book id or part index does not exist — read index.json/toc.json first. Parts are numbered 0..nparts-1 as 4-digit files.
